context: A Kansai chef and a barista trade lunch-rush stories
purpose: Teach: 丼/宴会/唇/食物/爪/昨晩/汚い/症候群

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 昨晩な、団体の宴会が入ってもうて、もう厨房えらいことやってん。
lines.en: Last night a big banquet came in, and the kitchen was absolute chaos.
lines.style: Kansai chef venting casually with exhausted humor

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: うわぁ、それは大変でしたね。うちも昼のピークで唇カサカサになるくらい喋り続けましたよ。
lines.en: Oh wow, that sounds rough. We had a lunch peak where I talked till my lips went dry.
lines.style: Sympathetic barista replying with warm conversational tone

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: せやろ?しかもお客さんの一人が食物アレルギーあるって直前に言うてきはってな、慌てたわ。
lines.en: Right? And on top of that, one customer mentioned a food allergy at the last minute, total panic.
lines.style: Kansai chef sharing kitchen drama with animated delivery

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: それ怖いですよね。ちゃんと対応できたんですか?
lines.en: That's really scary. Were you able to handle it properly?
lines.style: Concerned barista asking a gentle follow-up question

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: なんとかな。海鮮丼の具を全部入れ替えて出したわ。爪の先まで神経使うで、ほんま。
lines.en: Somehow, yeah. Swapped out all the seafood bowl toppings. You're on edge down to your fingernails, I tell ya.
lines.style: Kansai chef boasting with self-deprecating fatigue

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: プロですね。私なんて、忙しいとカウンターが汚いままになっちゃって、後で店長に怒られます。
lines.en: That's a true pro. When I'm slammed, the counter stays dirty and the manager scolds me later.
lines.style: Barista admitting weakness with light self-mocking laugh

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: あー、わかるわ。これな、完全に飲食店あるあるの燃え尽き症候群やで。
lines.en: Ah, I get it. That's the classic burnout syndrome of the restaurant world, for sure.
lines.style: Kansai chef commiserating with knowing older-brother warmth

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 本当にそれです。今度ぜひ大地さんのお店に丼食べに行かせてください。
lines.en: Honestly, that's exactly it. Next time I'd love to come eat a rice bowl at your place.
lines.style: Barista closing warmly with a friendly invitation
